messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Hey @Tomo — quick check on your visa plan. Are you still planning to do consular stamping in Tokyo next week?
Carlos (Talent): Yes, Tomo mentioned last week he's aiming for an appointment on the 12th. Wanted to confirm because benefits + payroll timeline depend on your official start date.
Tomo (New Hire): Correct — appointment booked for Tue 2024-05-12. Consulate gave a 7-10 business day turnaround for stamping. Hoping to be back and in US by end of May.
Aisha (People Ops): OK. Two things we need to coordinate: 1) I-9: federal rules require physical verification within 3 business days of your start date if you start in the US. If you start while abroad, we can't complete the I-9 remotely unless you use an authorized agent or we delay the start. 2) Benefits: medical/dental enrollment eligibility depends on your payroll start. If you start after your visa stamping and entry, we can enroll you for the following month.
Tomo (New Hire): Is there a way to start before I get my visa? I can begin remote onboarding (docs, Slack, trainings) from Japan.
Carlos (Talent): We can do onboarding tasks, but we can't set an official payroll start or enable benefits until your work authorization is in-place (entry on H-1B). For payroll purposes we'd need a US start date.
Aisha (People Ops): Right. Option A: Official start date = entry date after stamping. We do onboarding remotely (not paid) as "preboarding" — training materials, account setup, but no access to production systems that require an active employee account. Option B: If you want to be paid earlier, we can discuss contracting through an EOR for the interim, but that requires sign-off from Finance + higher cost.
Tomo (New Hire): I prefer to avoid contractor/EOR if possible. So delay official start to after entry. Could you prepare a visa support/travel letter for the consulate? I might need proof of employment and anticipated US start date for the appointment.
Aisha (People Ops): Yep — we can issue a standard travel/verification letter. I'll prep a draft with: job title, offer date, employer EIN, anticipated US start date (pending stamping), and basic salary info. Share your passport name and consulate appointment details and I'll attach it.
ImmigrationBot: Reminder: passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond intended date of entry. Also bring original degree + copies of petition (if available).
Tomo (New Hire): Passport is valid through 2027. I can upload a scanned copy here. Also attaching DS-160 confirmation and appointment confirmation.
Aisha (People Ops): Great. Please upload to the secure HR folder link: https://redwood-internal.sec/people-ops/visa-uploads (use only from personal device). I'll generate the letter and request a signature from Legal. Expect draft in ~24 hours.
Carlos (Talent): For benefits enrollment: if your US entry date is on or before May 31 we'll put your benefits effective 06/01. If later, effective date will be the first of the next month after payroll start. We'll send the benefits packet once your start date is finalized.
Tomo (New Hire): Understood. If the consulate delays stamping beyond 10 business days, I should update you immediately?
Aisha (People Ops): Please do. If there's a delay >2 weeks we should revisit start date and whether short-term contractor pay is appropriate. Also FYI — remote I-9 verifier: we can offer a list of local notaries/authorized agents in Tokyo who have previously worked with Redwood hires; that would let us complete the I-9 while you're abroad. It requires an extra verification form.
Tomo (New Hire): Can you share the notary list? That might be faster than waiting for me to travel back.
Aisha (People Ops): I'll attach the list with instructions in the draft letter. It includes pricing and how to schedule. If you go this route, we need completed Section 2 within 3 business days of your chosen US start date — so coordinate closely.
ImmigrationBot: Note: If Section 2 is completed abroad by an authorized representative, HR must retain a copy of the verifier's statement for audit.
Carlos (Talent): I'll keep the offer/LOE flexible for the start date until we have confirmation. Tomo — thanks for the uploads. Ping us if you need a one-pager for the consulate.
Tomo (New Hire): Thanks everyone — will upload DS-160 + appointment now and follow up if anything changes. Appreciate the help :bow:
